scope: Bounded maintenance under unchanged constructor/image-format/public contracts. No generated new product interface or storage architecture.

typedAtom.input: version, admitted record index and read-only image bytes
typedAtom.output: version2 persisted Java-hash equality or IOException
typedAtom.delta: Guard existing private helper with version2; keep javaHash(payload) evaluation before stored data.getInt(entry+8), exactly matching original v2 order.

reuse.rationale: The exact hash function and version-2 validation already exist. Only remove a discarded version1 computation. No new algorithm/API/provider or cache.

qualification.source: before/after existing RAM compiler + 47 pinned JARs; existing Java snapshot recipe
qualification.functional: exact v1/v2 text/identity/range/order/corruption/provider-absence behavior; malformed v2 Java hashes must still refuse
qualification.mechanism: QA-only ASM counter at existing javaHash(I)I entry: version1 count becomes0; version2 stays per-record
qualification.performance: uninstrumented real constructor timing/allocation on bounded direct-memory image, ABBA fresh JVMs; diagnostic, not proof of mapped-file startup/throughput
qualification.publicOpen: one <=4096B fixture under S, one live file only; original writer/public reader and cleanup after child exit
nonClaims: no performance guarantee from noisy micro timings
no complete old filesystem suite rerun
